concepts.title: Area of a Parallelogram
concepts.definition: The surface area contained inside a parallelogram, computed by multiplying the length of any base side by its perpendicular distance to the opposite vertex.
concepts.key_idea: The space covered by a parallelogram matches a rectangle having an identical base and altitude.
question_patterns: find the area of a parallelogram with base {base} and height {height}
calculate the surface region of a parallelogram having base {base} cm and altitude {height} cm
what is the area of a parallelogram if its base is {base} and corresponding height is {height}
determine the area enclosed by a parallelogram with given side {base} and perpendicular height {height}

solution_steps.explain: area is the product of base and height

concepts.title: Finding Unknown Dimension of a Parallelogram
concepts.definition: Determining an missing base or perpendicular height of a parallelogram when its total area and the other corresponding length are provided.
concepts.key_idea: Divide the total surface area by the known side to isolate the corresponding altitude or base.
question_patterns: find the height of a parallelogram if its area is {area} and base is {base}
calculate the base of a parallelogram given area {area} and height {height}
what is the missing side length if area of parallelogram is {area} and altitude is {height}
determine the corresponding perpendicular height for a parallelogram of area {area} and base {base}

solution_steps.action: divide area by given side or altitude
solution_steps.explain: rearranging area = base * height gives missing dimension = area / given_dimension

concepts.title: Area of a Triangle
concepts.definition: The measure of two-dimensional space enclosed within three connected line segments, calculated as half the product of base and corresponding height.
concepts.key_idea: A triangular region is exactly half of the parallelogram formed on the same base and height.
question_patterns: find the area of a triangle with base {base} and height {height}
calculate the area of triangle given base {base} cm and altitude {height} cm
what is the space enclosed by a triangle of base {base} and height {height}
determine the area of a triangular plot with base {base} and altitude {height}

solution_steps.action: multiply half of the base by the height
solution_steps.explain: area of a triangle is half of base times altitude

concepts.title: Finding Unknown Dimension of a Triangle
concepts.definition: Computing an unstated altitude or base of a triangle when the overall area and one side length are known.
concepts.key_idea: Multiply area by two and divide by the known dimension to evaluate the missing parameter.
question_patterns: find the height of a triangle if area is {area} and base is {base}
calculate the base of a triangle having area {area} and perpendicular height {height}
what is the altitude of a triangle with area {area} and side {base}
determine the unknown base of a triangle given total area {area} and height {height}

solution_steps.explain: twice the area equals base times height

solution_steps.action: divide double area by given dimension
solution_steps.explain: missing dimension is double area divided by the known side

concepts.title: Area and Congruence Relation of Triangles
concepts.definition: The geometric principle stating that identical (congruent) triangles always possess equal surface areas, whereas equal areas do not imply congruence.
concepts.formula: area(T1) = area(T2) when T1 is congruent to T2
concepts.key_idea: Congruent figures share identical area, but non-congruent figures can also share equal area.
question_patterns: are congruent triangles equal in area
do triangles with equal areas have to be congruent
verify if two congruent triangles enclose equal region
check whether equal area guarantees congruence in triangles

solution_steps.explain: if two triangles superimpose completely, their bounded areas are identical
triangles with equal base and height have equal areas regardless of side shape, so equal area does not imply congruence

concepts.title: Circumference of a Circle
concepts.definition: The total boundary length or perimeter along the outer curved edge of a circular shape.
concepts.key_idea: The ratio of circular perimeter to diameter is constant and equal to pi.
question_patterns: find the circumference of a circle with radius {radius}
calculate the perimeter of a circular ring of diameter {diameter}
what is the boundary length around a circle of radius {radius}
determine the distance around a circular disc with radius {radius}

solution_steps.explain: circumference equals 2 times pi times radius

concepts.title: Finding Radius or Diameter from Circumference
concepts.definition: Calculating the inner radius or straight diameter of a circular boundary when given its perimeter length.
concepts.key_idea: Dividing boundary length by two pi gives the radial distance from center to edge.
question_patterns: find the radius of a circle having circumference {circumference}
calculate the diameter of a circular sheet given circumference {circumference}
what is the radius of a wire loop of total length {circumference}
determine the diameter of a circle with perimeter {circumference}

solution_steps.explain: radius is total perimeter divided by 2 times pi

concepts.title: Perimeter of a Semicircular Region
concepts.definition: The combined boundary measure of a half-circle, formed by its curved semi-circumference plus its linear diameter.
concepts.key_idea: Add the straight bounding diameter to half the perimeter of a full circle.
question_patterns: find the perimeter of a semicircular disc of radius {radius}
calculate the total boundary length of a semicircle with diameter {diameter}
what is the perimeter of a halved circular shape of radius {radius}
determine perimeter including diameter for a semicircle of radius {radius}

solution_steps.explain: curved boundary of semicircle is pi times radius
straight boundary is twice the radius
total perimeter is arc length plus diameter

concepts.title: Area of a Circle
concepts.definition: The total surface extent enclosed within the circular boundary, evaluated using the square of radius times pi.
concepts.key_idea: Area scales quadratically with radius multiplied by constant pi.
question_patterns: find the area of a circle with radius {radius}
calculate the surface region of a circular garden of diameter {diameter}
what is the area enclosed by a circle of radius {radius}
determine the area of a circular sheet given radius {radius}

solution_steps.action: compute area using pi times radius squared
solution_steps.explain: area of circle is pi multiplied by radius squared

concepts.title: Area of Concentric Circular Paths
concepts.definition: The region lying between two concentric circles of differing radii, found by subtracting inner circular area from outer area.
concepts.key_idea: Subtract the smaller concentric circle's area from the larger circle's area.
question_patterns: find the area of the path between two concentric circles of radii {outer_radius} and {inner_radius}
calculate the shaded area between an outer circle of radius {outer_radius} and inner circle of radius {inner_radius}
what is the region bounded between outer radius {outer_radius} and inner radius {inner_radius}
determine path region around circular flower bed of inner radius {inner_radius} with path width {width}

solution_steps.explain: outer area is pi times outer radius squared
inner area is pi times inner radius squared

solution_steps.action: subtract inner area from outer area
solution_steps.explain: path area is difference between outer and inner areas
